headline: Ceasefire collapses in the eastern provinces
body: Fighting has resumed near the river town of Marrow Ford after a two-day pause. Both sides blame the other for the first shot. Aid agencies have suspended convoys.

headline: Aid convoy stopped at a checkpoint
body: A twelve-truck food and medicine convoy has been held at a checkpoint for nine hours. Local officials say paperwork is incomplete; aid workers say the delay is deliberate.

headline: Regional mediators offer talks in a neutral capital
body: The regional organisation proposes face-to-face talks within ten days, on condition that the Council does not impose new sanctions meanwhile.

headline: Reports of weapons crossing the northern border
body: Satellite images published by an independent research group appear to show armoured vehicles crossing into Veloria. The images have not been verified.

headline: Refugee numbers double in a week
body: Neighbouring states report that more than 80,000 people have crossed from Veloria in seven days. One neighbour has asked the Council for emergency funding.

headline: Both sides agree to a 72-hour humanitarian pause
body: The parties will hold fire for three days to let aid through, if the Council guarantees independent monitors. The offer expires at midnight.
